name: NHPC Ltd
title: NHPC Ltd - 533098 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 PAT Rs 1,460 Cr was inflated by a one-off Rs 1,156 Cr DTL reversal (about Rs 900 Cr net), so adjusted earnings are weaker; FY26 generation up 16% but PAF down to 74.75%.

utilisation.quote: Our PAF for FY’26 stands at 74.75% against the corresponding previous period PAF of 78.87%, which is about 4% lower.

capex.quote: CAPEX during FY’26 is Rs. 13,689 Crore as against Rs. 11,596 Crore in the corresponding period of previous year on consolidated basis.

triggers.label: PAF 74.75% vs 78.87%

triggers.label: Subansiri units: 4 of 8 commissioned, rest by Mar'27
triggers.quote: Remaining four units are expected to be commissioned one -by-one till March'27.

triggers.quote: We have been booking our revenue based on the 80% of the total expected AFC in Subansiri Lower and Parbati-II, both.
